dashboard.pipelineClosed_other: {{count}} musharrax ayaa ka baxay marxaladaha (waa la diiday, way iska noqdeen, ama uma jawaabin fursadda).

dashboard.noApplicationsHint: Codsiyadu halkan ayay ka soo muuqanayaan isla marka arday uu codsado mid ka mid ah tababarradaada la daabacay.
dashboard.noActivePostsHint: Daabac tababar qabyo ah, wuxuuna halkan ka soo muuqan doonaa tiradiisa codsiyada la socoto.
dashboard.noInternsHint: Tababare halkan wuxuu ka soo muuqanayaa marka musharrax aqbalo dalabkaaga oo uu bilaabo shaqada.

setup.title: Diyaari ururkaaga
setup.body: Abuur goobta shaqada ururkaaga — waxaad ku dari kartaa asxaabtaada marka la abuuro. Si aad u daabacdo tababarro, FursadHub waa inuu marka hore xaqiijiyaa ururkaaga: waxaad ka soo gelin doontaa dukumeentiga diiwaangelinta ururka profile-ka ururka, kadibna u gudbin doontaa dib-u-eegis.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Fadlan hubi foomka oo isku day mar kale.
errors.generic: Hadda lama abuuri karin ururkaaga. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.

setup.registrationNumberHint: Lambarka rasmiga ah ee diiwaangelinta ama shatiga ee ku qoran dukumeentiga diiwaangelinta ururkaaga. Weligii laguma muujiyo profile-kaaga dadweynaha.

publicProfile.noOpportunities: Hay'addani hadda ma leh tababaro la daabacay.

profile.title: Astaanta ururka

logo.hint: JPEG ama PNG, ilaa 3MB. Waxaa si guud loogu muujiyaa fursadahaaga iyo astaantaada.
logo.label: Soo geli astaan

profile.submitForVerificationBody: Ururkaaga waa in la xaqiijiyaa ka hor inta aadan daabicin fursadaha.

evidence.label: Shatiga ganacsiga ama diiwaangelinta
evidence.hint: PDF oo keliya, ilaa 10 MB. Soo gelinta fayl cusub waxay beddeshaa kan hadda kaydsan.
evidence.attached: Dukumeenti shati ah ayaa la diiwaangeliyay.
evidence.required: Ku lifaaq dukumeentigaaga shatiga ka hor inta aadan u gudbin xaqiijinta.
evidence.privacy: Waa sir — kaliya shaqaalaha ururkaaga iyo kooxda xaqiijinta FursadHub ayaa furi kara.

errors.ORGANIZATION_VERIFICATION_INVALID_TRANSI: Ururkan lagama gudbin karo xaqiijinta xaaladdiisa hadda.
errors.ORGANIZATION_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE_REQUI: Ku lifaaq dukumeentigaaga shatiga ka hor inta aadan u gudbin xaqiijinta.
errors.ORGANIZATION_EVIDENCE_FILE_INVALID: Faylkaasi lama aqbalo — soo geli PDF ka yar 10MB.
errors.ORGANIZATION_LOGO_FILE_INVALID: Faylkaasi lama aqbalo — soo geli JPEG ama PNG ka yar 3MB.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Faylku wuu ka weyn yahay xadka ugu badan ee la ogol yahay.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Fadlan hubi foomka oo isku day mar kale.
errors.generic: Taasi ma dhammaystirmin. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale — boggani wuxuu muujinayaa waxa hadda kaydsan.
errors.invalidUrl: Geli cinwaan buuxa oo ku bilaabma http:// ama https://
errors.invalidCountry: Isticmaal laba xaraf oo dal ah.
errors.invalidYear: Geli sannad aasaas oo u dhexeeya 1800 iyo maanta.

profile.subtitle: Diiwaanka dadweynaha ee ururkaaga iyo xaaladdiisa xaqiijinta.
profile.detailsHint: Waxa ardayda iyo jaamacaduhu arkaan marka ay ku eegaan.
profile.shortDescriptionHint: Hal sadar oo ka muuqda kaarkaaga tusmada dadweynaha. Ilaa 200 xaraf.
profile.companySizeHint: Kala dhexaad, ma aha tirada saxda ah ee shaqaalaha.

cover.label: Sawirka daboolka
cover.hint: JPG ama PNG. Waxa uu ka muuqdaa astaanta profile-kaaga dadweynaha.
cover.emptyHint: Weli sawir daboolka ah ma jiro. Mid soo geli si profile-kaagu u helo astaan.
cover.replaceHint: Soo gelinta sawir cusub waxay bedeshaa kan hadda jira.

profile.verificationRestrictions: Inta aan lagu xaqiijin, weli waxaad samayn kartaa tababarro qabyo ah, dooran kartaa jaamacadaha la beegsanayo, kuna dari kartaa shaqaale — kaliya daabacaadda iyo dib-u-bilaabidda tababarrada ayaa sugaya xaqiijinta.

verificationNext.title: Maxaa xiga
verificationNext.attach: Ku lifaaq dukumeentigaaga, kadibna dooro "U gudbi xaqiijinta".
verificationNext.review: Kooxda xaqiijinta FursadHub ayaa dib u eegaysa dukumeentigaaga iyo faahfaahinta ururkaaga.
verificationNext.notify: Waa lagu wargelin doonaa marka ururkaaga la xaqiijiyo, ama haddii kooxdu codsato isbeddello.

staff.title: Shaqaalaha
staff.passwordLabel: Furaha sirta ah ee ku-meel-gaarka ah
staff.resetPassword: Dib u deji furaha sirta ah
staff.resetPasswordOnceWarning: Furahan sirta ah hal mar ayaa la muujinayaa. Hadda la wadaag shaqaalaha.

errors.STAFF_ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: Akoonkan kama maamuli kartid maaraynta shaqaalaha.
errors.STAFF_PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: Furaha sirta ah iyo xaqiijintiisu isku mid ma aha.
errors.USER_CLOSED: Akoon la xiray lama hakin karo ama dib looma firfircoonayn karo.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: Kaliya maamulaha ururka ayaa maamuli kara shaqaalaha.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Fadlan hubi foomka oo isku day mar kale.
errors.generic: Codsigu ma dhammaystirmin. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale — liiska shaqaaluhu wuxuu muujinayaa xaaladda hadda ee qof kasta.
errors.USERNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS: Magaca isticmaalahaas horey ayaa loo qaatay.
errors.USERNAME_IMMUTABLE: Akoonkani horey ayuu u leeyahay magac isticmaale, lamana beddeli karo.
errors.STAFF_ADMIN_MEMBERSHIP_PROTECTED: Xisaabaadka maamulaha hay'adda lagama beddeli karo maaraynta shaqaalaha. Isticmaal goobaha akoonkaaga si aad u beddesho furahaaga sirta ah.

staff.subtitle: Abuur oo maamul akoonnada shaqaalaha gudaha ee ururka.
staff.createHint: Akoonku wuxuu noqonayaa mid firfircoon, waxaanu ku soo galayaa gelitaanka caadiga ah ee FursadHub. Shaqaaluhu iskuma diiwaangeliyaan.
staff.roleHint: Qorayaashu waxay wadaan qorista; kormeerayaasha waxaa lagu xilsaaraa tababarayaal gaar ah.
staff.emptyHint: Weli akoon shaqaale ma jiro. Mid abuur si aad u wareejiso qorista ama kormeerka.
staff.usernameHint: Shaqaaluhu tan ayuu ku soo gelayaa. Xarfo yaryar, tirooyin, dhibco, xariiqyo hoose ama jajab.
staff.displayNameHint: Sida qofkan uga muuqdo FursadHub. Ikhtiyaari.
staff.assignUsernameTitle: U qoondee magac isticmaale oo gelitaan
staff.assignUsernameHint: Tani waa mid joogto ah. Marka la qoondeeyo, akoonku wuxuu ku soo galayaa magaca isticmaalaha, emailkuna wuxuu joojinayaa inuu noqdo aqoonsi.

confirm.suspendBody: Waa laga saarayaa qalab kasta, mana soo geli karaan ilaa aad dib u howlgeliso.
confirm.resetPasswordTitle: Ma dib u dejinaysaa furaha sirta ah ee {{name}}?
confirm.resetPasswordBody: Furaha sirta ah ee hadda jira wuu joogsanayaa, waxaana laga saarayaa meel kasta. Hal mar ayaad arki doontaa furaha sirta ah ee ku meel gaarka ah — si ammaan ah ugu gudbi.
confirm.revokeBody: Isla markiiba waxay waayayaan gelitaanka goobtan shaqada. Tan dib looma celin karo.

feedback.suspendDone: {{name}} waa la hakiyay, waxaana laga saaray meel kasta.
feedback.reactivateDone: {{name}} mar kale ayuu soo geli karaa.
feedback.revokeDone: {{name}} hadda ma laha gelitaanka goobta shaqada ururkan.
feedback.resetPasswordFailed: Dib looma dejin karin furaha sirta ah ee {{name}}.

partners.empty: Weli jaamacad iskaashi ah ma jirto
partners.emptyHint: Jaamacaddu halkan way ka soo muuqataa marka ardaydeeda mid meelayn kula bilaabo.

recruiterDashboard.title: Guudmarka qorista
recruiterDashboard.subtitle: Cida ku sugaysa iyo cida aad sugayso.
recruiterDashboard.needsAttentionHint: Kii ugu sugayay muddada dheer horeba — kuwii ugu horreeyay ee codsaday.
recruiterDashboard.liveOffersHint: Kii xilligiisu ugu dhow horeba. Halkan ardayga ayaa go’aansanaya.

supervisorDashboard.subtitle: Tababarayaasha aad kormeerto, iyo waxa ku sugaya.
supervisorDashboard.placementOverviewHint: Meelaynta lagu xilsaaray, marxaladahooda oo dhan.
supervisorDashboard.partialError: Qaar ka mid ah diiwaannada lama akhriyi karin, sidaas awgeed tirooyinkani ma buuxsami karaan.

supervision.title: Safkaaga
supervision.subtitle: Xaadiriska iyo qiimeynta ku sugaya, tababarayaasha aad kormeerto oo dhan.
supervision.scanned_one: Waa la eegay {{count}} tababar oo socda.
supervision.scanned_other: Waa la eegay {{count}} tababar oo socda.
supervision.scannedPartial: Waa la eegay {{scanned}}-kii ugu horreeyay ee {{total}} tababar oo socda.
supervision.partialError: Qaar ka mid ah tababarrada lama akhriyi karin, halkanna kama muuqdaan.
supervision.noRunningPlacementsHint: Kaliya tababarrada hadda socda ayaa lahaan kara diiwaanno la xallinayo.
supervision.attendanceClearHint: Maalin kasta oo aad diiwaangelisay waa la xaqiijiyay ama la xalliyay.
supervision.evaluationProgress: {{done}} ka mid ah {{total}} qiimeyn ayaa la buuxiyay
supervision.evaluationsClearHint: Waxba kuuma harin tababarayaasha aad kormeerto.

verificationGate.title: Xaqiijin ayaa loo baahan yahay daabacaadda
verificationGate.body: Ururkaagu hadda waa {{status}}. Tababarrada waa la daabici karaa oo keliya marka FursadHub uu xaqiijiyo ururkaaga.

statusGuidance.DRAFT: Ku lifaaq dukumeentiga diiwaangelinta profile-ka ururka kadibna u gudbi xaqiijinta.
statusGuidance.SUBMITTED: Codsigaagu wuxuu la joogaa FursadHub. Waa lagu wargelin doonaa marka dib-u-eegistu dhammaato.
statusGuidance.UNDER_REVIEW: FursadHub wuxuu dib u eegayaa codsigaaga. Waa lagu wargelin doonaa marka la dhammeeyo.
statusGuidance.NEEDS_CHANGES: FursadHub wuxuu codsaday isbeddello. Cusbooneysii profile-ka ururka kadibna dib u gudbi.
statusGuidance.REJECTED: Xaqiijintaadii waa la diiday. La xiriir FursadHub ka hor inta aadan dib u gudbin.
statusGuidance.SUSPENDED: Xaqiijintaadu waa hakad. La xiriir FursadHub si loo xalliyo.
statusGuidance.REVOKED: Xaqiijintaadii waa la burburiyay. La xiriir FursadHub si loo xalliyo.
